name: Apogee Acquisition Corp Units
summary: Apogee Acquisition Corp's primary objective is to execute various types of business combinations. This includes a range of strategic transactions such as mergers, amalgamations, share swaps, purchasing assets or shares, or undertaking corporate reorganizations with one or more entities. The company was founded in 2025 and maintains its principal place of business in Cheyenne, Wyoming, operating as an entity controlled by Apogee Acquisition Sponsor LLC.
